name: menorah-production-qa
description: Safe production QA smoke tests for Menorah.

scripts.test:release-workflow: node validate-release-workflow.mjs && node validate-functional-workflow.mjs && node --test validate-release-workflow.test.mjs validate-functional-workflow.test.mjs compose-clean-checkout.test.mjs
scripts.test:monitoring: node validate-monitoring-config.mjs && node --test validate-monitoring-config.test.mjs validate-alertmanager-delivery.test.mjs docker-metrics-gateway.test.mjs docker-stats-exporter.test.mjs && bash test-monitoring-native.sh
scripts.test:all-safe: npm run test:tunnel-config && npm run test:smoke-safety
